sources.title: ZeRO: Memory Optimizations Toward Training Trillion Parameter Models
sources.note: Primary ZeRO paper (Rajbhandari et al. SC 2020). Used ar5iv HTML version for formula extraction (16Ψ=2Ψ+2Ψ+12Ψ, stage-by-stage breakdown, 7.5B model example).

sources.title: ZeRO ar5iv full HTML (formula extraction)
sources.note: HTML render of ZeRO paper; source for exact per-GPU numbers at each ZeRO stage (DDP=120GB, ZeRO-1=31GB, ZeRO-2=17GB, ZeRO-3=1.9GB for 7.5B @ Nd=64).

sources.title: Megatron-LM: Training Multi-Billion Parameter Language Models (Shoeybi 2019)
sources.note: Establishes column-then-row TP split for MLP and attention; 8.3B on 512 GPUs at 15.1 PFLOPs.

sources.title: Reducing Activation Recomputation in Large Transformer Models (Korthikanti 2022)
sources.note: Introduces sequence parallelism for non-TP regions (layer norm, dropout = 10sbh term). Final formula: (sbh/t)(34+5as/h). Also introduces selective recomputation (~5× activation savings, <2% extra FLOPs). Used ar5iv version for formulas.

sources.title: Korthikanti 2022 ar5iv (formula extraction)
sources.note: HTML render with activation memory formulas before/after SP.

sources.title: GPipe: Efficient Training of Giant Neural Networks using Pipeline Parallelism
sources.note: Original pipeline parallelism paper. Bubble = (p-1)/m. Re-materialization for activation memory. 557M AmoebaNet, 6B multilingual Transformer.

sources.title: Efficient Large-Scale Language Model Training on GPU Clusters Using Megatron-LM (Narayanan 2021)
sources.note: Introduces synchronous 1F1B and interleaved 1F1B. Same bubble as GPipe but O(p) not O(m) activation memory. Used Berkeley PDF version and secondary search for formula details.

sources.title: PyTorch FSDP: Experiences on Scaling Fully Sharded Data Parallel
sources.note: Zhao et al. 2023. FSDP = ZeRO-3 in PyTorch. Flat-parameter design, all-gather per FSDP unit, HYBRID_SHARD for multi-node. Communication = 3Ψ vs DDP 2Ψ.

sources.title: GShard: Scaling Giant Models with Conditional Computation and Automatic Sharding
sources.note: Lepikhin et al. ICLR 2021. Pioneers expert parallelism with top-2 routing, all-to-all dispatch+combine, capacity factor. 600B params on 2048 TPU v3.

sources.title: DeepSpeed-MoE: Advancing Mixture-of-Experts Inference and Training
sources.note: Rajbhandari et al. ICML 2022. Combines EP + DP + TP + ZeRO for MoE training at scale. Each GPU holds E/EP_size experts.

sources.title: The Ultra-Scale Playbook: Training LLMs on GPU Clusters (HuggingFace)
sources.note: Canonical practitioner reference. Contains complete per-GPU memory formula assembly including logit-buffer spike (vocab × seq × batch × 2 bytes), ZeRO-3 formula (16Ψ/N), and phase-boundary peak discussion.

sources.title: HuggingFace Transformers: Model Memory Anatomy
sources.note: Official HF doc. 4B model on batch=16 requires ~85GB. Memory breakdown table: weights 6 bytes/param (2B fp16 + 4B fp32 master), optimizer 8 bytes/param (Adam m+v), gradients 4 bytes/param fp32.

sources.title: ml-engineering: Machine Learning Engineering Open Book (stas00)
sources.note: Canonical practitioner OOM debugging reference. Memory profiling with IPyExperiments, torch.cuda.memory_stats, activation memory calculation per layer examples, PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF fragmentation fix.

sources.title: Stop Guessing: Systematic Guide to CUDA OOM in GRPO Training (MLOps Community)
sources.note: Best practitioner source for the 4-step debugging loop (Read error → Map consumers → Calculate → Target levers). Phase identification via traceback. Ordered levers with GPU_MEMORY_UTILIZATION first.
